description: This file defines the Country controller class for the Admin panel of an OpenCart-based project. It manages CRUD operations, listing, filtering, enabling/disabling, and retrieving country data, including interactions with models such as 'localisation/country', 'localisation/language', and others. It also constructs URLs, handles permissions, and prepares data for views related to country management within the localization module.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class handling country management in the OpenCart admin interface, extending the base Controller class, providing functionality for listing, filtering, adding, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting country records, and retrieving country data via AJAX calls.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for country management, sets up the page, loads language, constructs breadcrumbs, URLs, and loads list of countries.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to load the country list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of countries, applying filters, sorting, pagination, and fetching data from the country model.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a country. Loads existing country data if editing, and provides options for address formats, languages, and other country details.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a country (create or update), validating input, permissions, and calling model methods accordingly. Responds with JSON.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected countries by updating their status to active via the model, with permission checks. Responds with JSON.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected countries by updating their status to inactive via the model, with permission checks. Responds with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected countries after performing validation and checking for dependencies like addresses, zones, geo zones, and default country. Responds with JSON.

methods.name: country
methods.description: Returns country and zone data for a given country ID via an AJAX response in JSON format.
